<!-- Rehearsal checklist · from Chapter 35 of The Product 360 Handbook -->

# Rehearsal checklist · [Meeting] · [Date]

## Content
- [ ] Full run, timed: [minutes] against a slot of [minutes]
- [ ] 5-minute cut run, timed
- [ ] 3-minute story said aloud without slides
- [ ] First 60 seconds and last 60 seconds said without notes
- [ ] Titles-only read: the action titles alone tell the story
- [ ] Someone outside the team says back the ask correctly

## Numbers
- [ ] Every number checked against its source; source in speaker notes
- [ ] Every chart's scale and axis checked
- [ ] Every estimative word ("likely," "most") has a number or range
- [ ] AI results show range and sample size

## Delivery
- [ ] Recorded run reviewed (or AI rehearsal report) for pace, filler words and reading slides
- [ ] Pause planned after the ask
- [ ] Numbers slowed down: number, unit, comparison

## Q&A
- [ ] Q&A prep sheet complete, ten questions
- [ ] Murder board run with the hardest personas (human or AI)
- [ ] Appendix slides findable in under ten seconds

## Setup
- [ ] Virtual: camera, audio, screen share, captions tested; self-view hidden
- [ ] Ask written in the chat or on screen for virtual audiences
- [ ] Demo: recorded fallback ready; scripted or prepared data labeled
- [ ] Pre-read sent [date]; follow-up template ready
- [ ] Deck built only in tools approved for this data
